# E(n) Extraction from ³⁵Al β⁻ Decay (38.1 ms)

Source: `Si35_35al_beta_decay_38.1_ms.ens`

## Formula

E(n)<sub>c.m.</sub> = E(level)(³⁵Si) − S(n)(³⁵Si) − E(level)(³⁴Si)

where:
- S(n)(³⁵Si) = 2474 ± 43 keV (2005Ti11), consistent with 2470 ± 40 (2021Wa16)
- n0: E(level)(³⁴Si) = 0 keV (ground state)
- n1: E(level)(³⁴Si) = 3326 keV (2005Ti11)
